title.de: Es gibt: there is, there are
title.sl: Je, so: there is, there are
title.it: C'è, ci sono: there is, there are

goal.sl: Poveš, kaj nekje je in česa ni (there's a …, there are …, there isn't a …, there aren't any …), vprašaš Is there …? Are there any …? s kratkimi odgovori in ločiš there is od it is.
goal.de: Du sagst, was es irgendwo gibt und was nicht (there's a …, there are …, there isn't a …, there aren't any …), fragst Is there …? Are there any …? mit Kurzantworten und hältst there is und it is auseinander.
goal.it: Dici che cosa c'è da qualche parte e che cosa non c'è (there's a …, there are …, there isn't a …, there aren't any …), chiedi Is there …? Are there any …? con le risposte brevi e distingui there is da it is.
goal.en: You can say what there is somewhere and what there isn't (there's a …, there are …, there isn't a …, there aren't any …), ask Is there …? Are there any …? with short answers, and tell there is from it is.

say.sl: Ko poveš, da nekaj nekje je, angleščina začne s **there**: **there is**, kratko **there's**, za eno stvar in za tisto, česar ne šteješ (čaj, mleko), **there are** za več: **There's a tent by the tarn.** (Ob jezercu je šotor.) **There are two tents by the tarn.** (Ob jezercu sta dva šotora.) **There are a lot of sheep on the fell.** (Na hribu je veliko ovc.)
say.de: Um zu sagen, dass es etwas irgendwo gibt, beginnt das Englische mit **there**: **there is**, kurz **there's**, für eine Sache und für das, was man nicht zählt (Tee, Milch), **there are** für mehrere: **There's a tent by the tarn.** (Am Bergsee steht ein Zelt.) **There are two tents by the tarn.** (Am Bergsee stehen zwei Zelte.) **There are a lot of sheep on the fell.** (Am Berg gibt es viele Schafe.)
say.it: Per dire che qualcosa c'è, l'inglese comincia con **there**: **there is**, breve **there's**, per una cosa e per ciò che non si conta (il tè, il latte), **there are** per più cose: **There's a tent by the tarn.** (C'è una tenda vicino al laghetto.) **There are two tents by the tarn.** (Ci sono due tende vicino al laghetto.) **There are a lot of sheep on the fell.** (Sul monte ci sono tante pecore.)
say.en: To say that something is somewhere, English starts with **there**: **there is**, short **there's**, for one thing and for what you don't count (tea, milk), **there are** for more: **There's a tent by the tarn.** **There are two tents by the tarn.** **There are a lot of sheep on the fell.**

examples.de: Über den Bach führt eine alte Brücke.
examples.it: Sul ruscello c'è un vecchio ponte.

examples.en: There are a lot of stars tonight.
examples.de: Heute Nacht gibt es viele Sterne.

say.sl: Za zanikanje gre **not** za is ali are: **there isn't** + a ali an, pri več stvareh **there aren't** + **any** (nobenih): **There isn't a shop in the village.** (V vasi ni trgovine.) **There aren't any shops.** (Trgovin ni.) Tudi pri tem, česar ne šteješ: **There isn't any milk.** (Mleka ni.)
say.de: Für nein kommt **not** nach is oder are: **there isn't** + a oder an, bei mehreren **there aren't** + **any** (keine): **There isn't a shop in the village.** (Im Dorf gibt es keinen Laden.) **There aren't any shops.** (Es gibt keine Läden.) Auch bei dem, was man nicht zählt: **There isn't any milk.** (Es gibt keine Milch.)
say.it: Per dire di no, **not** va dopo is o are: **there isn't** + a o an, con più cose **there aren't** + **any** (nessuno): **There isn't a shop in the village.** (In paese non c'è un negozio.) **There aren't any shops.** (Non ci sono negozi.) Anche con ciò che non si conta: **There isn't any milk.** (Non c'è latte.)
say.en: For no, **not** goes after is or are: **there isn't** + a or an, with more **there aren't** + **any**: **There isn't a shop in the village.** **There aren't any shops.** And with what you don't count: **There isn't any milk.**

examples.de: Im Dorf gibt es keinen Laden.
examples.it: In paese non c'è un negozio.

examples.sl: Mleka ni, je pa nekaj medu.
examples.de: Es gibt keine Milch, aber etwas Honig.
examples.it: Non c'è latte, ma c'è un po' di miele.

say.sl: Za vprašanje zamenjaj **there** in is ali are: **Is there a shop?** (Je tu kaka trgovina?) **Are there any fish in the tarn?** (So v jezercu ribe?) V vprašanju je **any**. Kratki odgovori: **Yes, there is.** **No, there isn't.** **Yes, there are.** **No, there aren't.** Nikoli *Yes, there's*.
say.de: Für die Frage tauschen **there** und is oder are den Platz: **Is there a shop?** (Gibt es hier einen Laden?) **Are there any fish in the tarn?** (Gibt es Fische im Bergsee?) In der Frage steht **any**. Die Kurzantworten: **Yes, there is.** **No, there isn't.** **Yes, there are.** **No, there aren't.** Nie *Yes, there's*.
say.it: Per chiedere, **there** e is o are si scambiano di posto: **Is there a shop?** (C'è un negozio?) **Are there any fish in the tarn?** (Ci sono pesci nel laghetto?) Nella domanda c'è **any**. Le risposte brevi: **Yes, there is.** **No, there isn't.** **Yes, there are.** **No, there aren't.** Mai *Yes, there's*.
say.en: To ask, **there** and is or are change places: **Is there a shop?** **Are there any fish in the tarn?** A question takes **any**. The short answers: **Yes, there is.** **No, there isn't.** **Yes, there are.** **No, there aren't.** Never *Yes, there's*.

say.sl: **How many** (koliko) vpraša po številu, s samostalnikom v množini: **How many sheep are there on the fell?** (Koliko ovc je na hribu?) **There are three hundred.** (Tristo.) Pri več stvareh v trdilnem stavku je pogosto **some** (nekaj): **There are some eggs in the kitchen.** (V kuhinji je nekaj jajc.)
say.de: **How many** (wie viele) fragt nach der Zahl, mit dem Nomen im Plural: **How many sheep are there on the fell?** (Wie viele Schafe gibt es am Berg?) **There are three hundred.** (Dreihundert.) Bei mehreren steht im bejahten Satz oft **some** (ein paar): **There are some eggs in the kitchen.** (In der Küche sind ein paar Eier.)
say.it: **How many** (quanti) chiede il numero, con il nome al plurale: **How many sheep are there on the fell?** (Quante pecore ci sono sul monte?) **There are three hundred.** (Trecento.) Con più cose, nella frase affermativa c'è spesso **some** (qualche, un po' di): **There are some eggs in the kitchen.** (In cucina ci sono delle uova.)
say.en: **How many** asks for the number, with the noun in the plural: **How many sheep are there on the fell?** **There are three hundred.** With more than one, a yes sentence often has **some**: **There are some eggs in the kitchen.**

say.sl: **there is** pove, da nekaj je; **it is** pove, kakšno je: **There's a bridge over the beck. It's very old.** (Čez potok je most. Zelo star je.) **There's a dog at the door. It's Meg!** (Pred vrati je pes. Meg je!) Ne *It's a bridge over the beck*, ko misliš, da most tam je.
say.de: **there is** sagt, dass es etwas gibt; **it is** sagt, wie es ist: **There's a bridge over the beck. It's very old.** (Über den Bach führt eine Brücke. Sie ist sehr alt.) **There's a dog at the door. It's Meg!** (Vor der Tür ist ein Hund. Es ist Meg!) Für es gibt nie *It is* oder *It gives*.
say.it: **there is** dice che una cosa c'è; **it is** dice com'è: **There's a bridge over the beck. It's very old.** (Sul ruscello c'è un ponte. È molto vecchio.) **There's a dog at the door. It's Meg!** (C'è un cane alla porta. È Meg!) Per c'è non si dice *It's*.
say.en: **there is** says that something is there; **it is** says what it is like: **There's a bridge over the beck. It's very old.** **There's a dog at the door. It's Meg!** Not *It's a bridge over the beck* when you mean that a bridge is there.

translation.sl: V naši vasi je na trgu stara gostilna. V gostilni je ob ognju veliko miz. Ob potoku je kovačnica, trgovin pa ni. — Je kak avtobus do Keswicka? — Ja. Dvakrat na dan.
translation.de: In unserem Dorf gibt es am Platz ein altes Gasthaus. Im Gasthaus stehen viele Tische am Feuer. Am Bach gibt es eine Schmiede, aber keine Läden. — Gibt es einen Bus nach Keswick? — Ja. Zweimal am Tag.
translation.it: Nel nostro paese c'è una vecchia locanda sulla piazza. Nella locanda ci sono tanti tavoli vicino al fuoco. Vicino al ruscello c'è una fucina, ma non ci sono negozi. — C'è un autobus per Keswick? — Sì. Due volte al giorno.
translation.en: In our village there is an old inn on the square. In the inn there are a lot of tables by the fire. There is a smithy by the beck, but there aren't any shops. — Is there a bus to Keswick? — Yes, there is. Twice a day.
